title: EU anti-dumping duties imposed on cold-rolled flat steel from India, Japan, Taiwan, Turkiye, Vietnam
dek: The EU has imposed anti-dumping duties on cold-rolled flat steel from India, Japan, Taiwan, Turkiye and Vietnam, Goodreturns reports.
summary: According to Goodreturns, the EU has imposed anti-dumping duties on cold-rolled flat steel from India, Japan, Taiwan, Turkiye and Vietnam. No excerpt was provided, so duty rates and company-specific margins are not given.
keyFacts: EU anti-dumping duties on cold-rolled flat steel
Countries covered: India, Japan, Taiwan, Turkiye, Vietnam
whyItMatters: The EU is a significant destination for Indian flat steel exports, and duties could reduce the competitiveness of Indian cold-rolled products there.
implications: Indian CRC exporters may need to redirect volumes to other markets, potentially adding supply pressure at home; EU buyers may face higher import costs.

related.title: Commission Implementing Regulation imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on cold-rolled steel imports from India, Japan, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam
related.dek: The European Commission has issued a regulation imposing definitive anti-dumping duties on cold-rolled steel imports from India, Japan, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam, EU Law Live reports.
